context.title: A connected worldview
context.text: Ideas from physics and knowledge theory recur in discussions of other subjects. Their reach is part of what the interviews invite readers to test.

notice.why: Repetition can reveal a distinction obscured in a single formulation.
The question often determines what requires explanation.

opening: David Deutsch takes the human ability to explain things seriously enough to give it consequences far beyond science. In these interviews, questions about knowledge open into arguments about computation, creativity, and what people might become capable of doing. The conversational form lets interviewers pause over claims a finished philosophical system might carry past too quickly. Across conversations recorded at different times, a reader can follow a powerful set of ideas being explained, challenged, and developed by someone willing to make unusually large claims for their reach.
